answers.valueEn: Rust, paint bubbling, and early corrosion under the car body and the edges of both sills due to humidity. Broken front emblem. Broken chrome on the front grille, broken chrome on front right headlight, and broken chrome on front right fog light. Yellowing of front LED lights. Peeling chrome on dashboard AC vents and steering wheel emblem. Wear and peeling on the gear shift knob. Broken handle on the trunk floor cover. Broken extensions on both front and rear bumpers. Cut in the rear right door seal. Small cut in the hood insulation pad. Cracking in the leather of both front left and right seats. Burn mark on the headliner. Broken lighting component in the rear right control arm. Melted plastic on the center exhaust box. Burn mark on the sunroof curtain. Rear center console ashtray does not close properly.
